summary: Reimplemented footprint envelope protocol in BarStreamingActor. Added price_bin_size field to BarStreamingActorConfig (float, default 0.1). Refactored _buckets from dict[int, dict[str,float]] to dict[int, dict[int, dict[str,float]]] for per-minute, per-price-bin aggregation. Updated on_trade_tick to bucket by bin_index = floor(price / price_bin_size). Updated on_bar to aggregate across price bins, emit bar/cvd/footprint envelopes (3 per bar) with footprint seq = previous_cvd_seq + 1. Added price_bin_size parameter to create_backtest_queue(). Updated tests with price on MockTradeTick and new nested bucket assertions. Added test_footprint_envelope_emission.
